title: Movable pole extension for a magnetic clamping apparatus and magnetic clamping apparatus having such movable pole extension

features.item: A housing containing a displaceable magnet and pole shoes with workpiece contact surfaces.
features.quote: The present invention relates to a movable pole extension ( 4 ) for a magnetic clamping apparatus ( 1 ) for holding a ferromagnetic workpiece (P), comprising a fixed pole member ( 5 ) extending in a predetermined longitudinal direction
features.note: The reference describes a movable pole extension for a magnetic clamping apparatus, which includes a fixed pole member and movable pole members that act as pole shoes, for holding a workpiece.
features.refuted: Quote describes a movable pole extension with a fixed pole member, not a housing containing a displaceable magnet.

features.item: A magnet displaceable along a direction between a gripping position and a release position.
features.quote: The movable pole extension is characterized in that it has holder means ( 8 ) operably coupled to said fixed pole member ( 5 ), wherein said holder means ( 8 ) are movable in said predetermined longitudinal direction (X-X)
features.note: The reference describes holder means that are movable between two operating positions and operate on movable pole members. It does not explicitly state that the magnet itself is displaceable, but rather the holder means that act on the pole members.

features.item: Pole shoes attached to the housing, each with a workpiece contact surface.
features.quote: The present invention relates to a movable pole extension ( 4 ) for a magnetic clamping apparatus ( 1 ) for holding a ferromagnetic workpiece (P), comprising a fixed pole member ( 5 ) extending in a predetermined longitudinal direction
features.note: The reference describes 'at least two pole members (6, 7) attached to said fixed pole member (5)' for holding a ferromagnetic workpiece, implying they have workpiece contact surfaces.
features.refuted: Quote mentions pole members attached to a fixed pole member, not pole shoes attached to a housing.

features.item: Pole shoes designed to guide a magnetic field portion to the workpiece contact surface.
features.quote: The present invention relates to a movable pole extension ( 4 ) for a magnetic clamping apparatus ( 1 ) for holding a ferromagnetic workpiece (P), comprising a fixed pole member ( 5 ) extending in a predetermined longitudinal direction
features.note: The pole members are part of a magnetic clamping apparatus for holding a ferromagnetic workpiece, which inherently means they guide the magnetic field to the workpiece contact surface.
features.refuted: Quote only describes pole members and fixed pole member structure, says nothing about guiding magnetic field portions to workpiece contact surfaces.

features.item: A workpiece contact surface defining a contact surface angle of 170° to 190° with the displacement direction.
features.note: The reference does not disclose any specific angles for the workpiece contact surface relative to the displacement direction.

features.item: A magnetic gripper with housing, displaceable magnet, and pole shoes where contact surface angle is 170° to 190° relative to displacement direction.
features.note: The reference describes a magnetic clamping apparatus with movable pole members but does not specify the contact surface angle relative to the displacement direction.

features.item: A magnetic gripper system with a magnetic gripper and ferromagnetic workpiece, where magnet in gripping position presses workpiece against contact surfaces by magnetic force.
features.quote: The present invention relates to a movable pole extension ( 4 ) for a magnetic clamping apparatus ( 1 ) for holding a ferromagnetic workpiece (P)
features.note: The reference explicitly states its purpose is for 'holding a ferromagnetic workpiece (P)' with a magnetic clamping apparatus, implying the workpiece is held by magnetic force when in a gripping position.
features.refuted: Quote only mentions the apparatus holds a workpiece, not that a magnet in gripping position presses workpiece against contact surfaces by magnetic force.

features.item: Housing extending along a longitudinal axis with displacement direction parallel to that axis.
features.quote: a fixed pole member ( 5 ) extending in a predetermined longitudinal direction (X-X) and at least two pole members ( 6, 7 ) attached to said fixed pole member ( 5 ), said at least two pole members (
features.note: The fixed pole member extends in a longitudinal direction (X-X), and the holder means (which operate on the movable pole members) are movable in this same longitudinal direction, indicating the displacement direction is parallel to the longitudinal axis of the fixed pole member/housing.
features.refuted: Quote describes a fixed pole member extending in a longitudinal direction, not a housing extending along a longitudinal axis with displacement direction parallel to it.

features.item: Pole shoes with an active structure for directing the magnetic field portion.
features.quote: The present invention relates to a movable pole extension ( 4 ) for a magnetic clamping apparatus ( 1 ) for holding a ferromagnetic workpiece (P), comprising a fixed pole member ( 5 ) extending in a predetermined longitudinal direction
features.note: The pole members are for holding a workpiece, implying they direct the magnetic field. However, the reference does not explicitly describe an 'active structure' or specific features for directing the field.

features.item: An active structure with a bevel defining a bevel angle of 5° to 85° with the workpiece contact surface.
features.note: The reference does not describe any bevels or specific angles for an active structure on the pole shoes.

features.item: An active structure with multiple projections for directing magnetic field and forming the workpiece contact surface.
features.note: The reference does not describe multiple projections or an active structure with such features.

features.item: Adjacent first and second projections with a recess between them, recess depth or length deviating by at most 25% from projection length.
features.note: The reference does not describe projections or recesses on the pole members.

features.item: A positioning device on the magnetic gripper for positioning the ferromagnetic workpiece on the contact surface.
features.note: The reference does not describe any specific positioning device for the workpiece.

features.item: First and second pole shoes where the magnet in gripping position makes the first pole shoe act as north pole and second as south pole.
features.quote: The present invention relates to a movable pole extension ( 4 ) for a magnetic clamping apparatus ( 1 ) for holding a ferromagnetic workpiece (P), comprising a fixed pole member ( 5 ) extending in a predetermined longitudinal direction
features.note: The reference describes 'at least two pole members' for a magnetic clamping apparatus, implying they would form opposite poles to attract a workpiece. However, it does not explicitly state one acts as a north pole and the other as a south pole.

features.item: A magnet displaceable electrically, pneumatically, or mechanically between gripping and release positions.
features.quote: The movable pole extension is characterized in that it has holder means ( 8 ) operably coupled to said fixed pole member ( 5 ), wherein said holder means ( 8 ) are movable in said predetermined longitudinal direction (X-X)
features.note: The reference describes holder means that are movable between two operating positions, which implies a mechanism for displacement. However, it does not specify the actuation method (electrically, pneumatically, or mechanically).

features.item: A position sensor detecting gripping position and/or release position, or a workpiece sensor detecting the ferromagnetic workpiece.
features.note: The reference does not describe any sensors for detecting position or workpiece presence.

features.item: Housing with a receptacle for receiving a workpiece sensor and/or a supply line.
features.note: The reference does not describe a receptacle for a workpiece sensor or supply line.

features.item: A manipulator interface on the magnetic gripper for attaching to a manipulator.
features.note: The reference does not describe any manipulator interface.

features.item: Housing portion designed to suppress magnetic field escape, or a shielding device to at least partially prevent magnetic field escape.
features.note: The reference does not describe any features for suppressing magnetic field escape or shielding.

features.item: At least one projection with length deviating by at most 25% from the thickness of the ferromagnetic workpiece.
features.note: The reference does not describe projections or their dimensions relative to the workpiece thickness.

features.item: A receptacle in the form of a groove in the housing.

features.note: Claim 26 describes a receptacle (11) in the fixed pole member, which can be considered part of the housing, and a receptacle can be in the form of a groove.
features.refuted: Quote mentions a receptacle in the fixed pole member defining curved surfaces, not a receptacle in the form of a groove in the housing.

features.item: A bevel angle of 15° to 75° between the active structure bevel and the workpiece contact surface.
features.note: The reference does not describe any bevels or specific angles for an active structure on the pole shoes.

features.item: A bevel angle of 40° to 60° between the active structure bevel and the workpiece contact surface.
